protocol.network: Unthrottled loopback; optional normal response delayed 600 ms at server
protocol.cache: Fresh browser context per trial; CDP cache disabled; all responses no-store
protocol.trace: Chromium CDP timeline and screenshots, first block only; marked and summarized separately
protocol.success: Independent DOM observer finds exactly shoe-01/Canvas trainer and shoe-02/Walking shoe, visible and in order; final oracle must agree
protocol.failure: No correct result by 1500 ms after filter input: explicit-error or deadline; harness errors kept separately
protocol.analysis: All runs retained. Success-only median, Q1/Q3, min/max and nearest-rank p95; failures counted separately. No field INP or causal population estimate.

notes: Single sequential browser process; fresh context for each trial
Machine load, thermal state and power profile not controlled
No real CMP, external vendor, network or mobile hardware
Trace overhead: first block only; separate sensitivity summary
